info.title: runwick
info.description: runwick: the command-line tool for operators, CI scripts and AI agents (talks to a Runwick management host over HTTP).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List audit rows, newest first.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List concurrency scopes.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a scope's capacity.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Save a context: server URL, login method, user and the name of the secret's environment variable.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List saved contexts.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a saved context.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the current context (never a secret value).

commands.name: use
commands.description: Make a context current.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Create a job of a registered job type from a JSON payload (file or stdin); audited.

commands.name: tail
commands.description: Read job events after a cursor; --follow keeps polling.

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep polling after the last event.

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Cancel a job (a running job gets a cancel request).

commands.name: cancel-many
commands.description: Cancel up to 100 jobs listed as JSON Lines {jobId, expectedGeneration, expectedRevision}.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show a job with its generations and attempts (no payload).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List jobs, newest first.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).

commands.name: rerun
commands.description: Run a succeeded job again as a new generation.

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Retry a failed or cancelled job as a new generation.

commands.name: reveal-error
commands.description: Show an attempt's error; the server writes an audit row.

commands.name: reveal-payload
commands.description: Show a job's payload; the server writes an audit row.

commands.name: tail
commands.description: Follow a job until it ends: one item per state or revision change.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Check the current context's credentials; stores nothing.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Apply this CLI's store migrations.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List queues.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Pause a queue (stops new reservations).

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a paused queue.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List schedules.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Pause a schedule.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a schedule (--policy skipPaused|runOnce|catchUp).

commands.name: revalidate
commands.description: Revalidate a schedule that needs review.

commands.name: trigger
commands.description: Run a schedule now; the command ID is the trigger ID.

commands.name: settings
commands.description: Show the management host's settings (allowlisted).

commands.name: admission
commands.description: Set application admission: drain blocks new work, maintenance blocks everything but status reads; open reopens.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the store's revision, mode, application gates and the lease and presence rows (never proof that processes stopped).

options.name: --connection-env
options.description: Name of the environment variable holding the connection string.

options.name: --connection-stdin
options.description: Read the connection string from the first line of stdin.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List worker instances.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Continue from a list cursor (valid 15 minutes).
